The '''1st Lon Flotilla''' was a naval formation of the [[Freda system militias]]. It participated in [[Battle of the Rettna system|attack]] against [[Jante]] holdings in the [[Rettna system/Legends|Rettna system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The 1st assisted the 3rd and 5th Flotillas in repulsing a counter attack by Jante's [[Rett II orbital defense force|orbital defense force]] based at [[Rett II]].
